svg.title: Loading lines of the compliant-stalk model for initial stalk angles of 15, 30 and 45 degrees
svg.desc: Three force-space panels. In each, four lines show tip shear and normal force as the base is dragged 8 millimetres down the wall after preloads of 0, 2, 4 and 6 millimetres. The lines fan out from near the origin; a smaller initial angle gives lines closer to pure shear, a larger one gives steeper adhesion.

text.tspan: each line: base dragged 8 mm down the wall
